The counter increments when the mode is set to up (mode = 0) and decrements when the mode is set to down (mode = 1). It wraps around upon reaching its maximum (1111) or minimum (0000) values.     input en,
    input mode,
    output reg [3:0] count

            count <= 4'b0000;
        end else if (en) begin
            if (mode) begin
